use_cases.name: Media Playback from USB
use_cases.description: User connects a USB storage device and plays audio/video content
preconditions: Vehicle ignition is ON or ACC mode
USB device contains supported media formats
main_flow: User inserts USB device into front USB port
System detects USB device and scans for media files
System displays media library on screen
User selects media file for playback
System plays selected media through vehicle speakers
postconditions: Media playback continues until user stops or changes source
security_requirements: Media files must be scanned for malware before playback
USB device enumeration must be validated
Autorun functionality must be disabled

use_cases.name: Bluetooth Phone Pairing
use_cases.description: User pairs their smartphone with the IVI system via Bluetooth
preconditions: IVI Bluetooth is in discoverable mode
main_flow: User accesses Bluetooth settings on IVI
User initiates pairing from phone or IVI
System displays pairing code on IVI screen
User confirms pairing code on phone
System establishes secure connection
System syncs contacts and call history (if permitted)
postconditions: Phone is paired and can be used for hands-free calling
Phone contacts are available in IVI contacts app
security_requirements: Secure Simple Pairing (SSP) must be used
Pairing PIN must be displayed, not transmitted
Contact sync must require explicit user consent
Maximum 5 paired devices allowed

use_cases.name: Navigation Route Guidance
use_cases.description: User enters a destination and receives turn-by-turn navigation
main_flow: User enters destination via voice or touch
System calculates optimal route
System displays route on map with ETA
User confirms route selection
System provides turn-by-turn voice guidance
System updates route based on real-time traffic (if connected)
postconditions: Navigation guidance continues until destination is reached or cancelled
security_requirements: GNSS data must be validated for spoofing detection
Route data must not be logged without user consent
Cloud traffic services must use encrypted connection

use_cases.name: Over-The-Air (OTA) Update
use_cases.description: System receives and installs software updates over cellular network
preconditions: Vehicle is parked and ignition is OFF or ACC mode
main_flow: System checks for updates periodically or on user request
Backend server notifies available update
System downloads update package in background
System verifies package signature
System notifies user of pending update
User approves update installation
System installs update during next vehicle off cycle
System verifies successful installation on next boot
postconditions: System is updated to new software version
Update status is reported to backend
security_requirements: Update package must be signed with OEM private key
Package integrity must be verified (SHA-256)
Rollback capability must be available
Update must not occur while vehicle is in motion
Secure boot chain must verify updated components

use_cases.name: Remote Door Lock/Unlock via Mobile App
use_cases.description: User remotely locks or unlocks vehicle doors using smartphone app
preconditions: User is authenticated in mobile app
main_flow: User opens mobile app and authenticates
User selects lock/unlock function
App sends command to cloud backend
Backend validates user authorization
Backend sends command to vehicle T-BOX
T-BOX forwards command to IVI via secure channel
IVI sends CAN message to BCM
BCM actuates door locks
Confirmation is sent back to mobile app
postconditions: Event is logged in vehicle and backend
security_requirements: End-to-end encryption for command transmission
Multi-factor authentication for remote commands
Command must include timestamp and nonce
Rate limiting for remote commands (max 10/hour)
Geofencing for unlock commands (optional)

use_cases.name: Web Browsing
use_cases.description: Passenger browses the internet using built-in web browser
preconditions: WiFi or cellular data connection is available
Vehicle is not in motion (browser restricted while driving)
main_flow: User launches web browser application
User enters URL or search query
System fetches and renders web content
User navigates web pages
postconditions: Browser session ends when user closes application or vehicle powers off
security_requirements: Browser must run in sandboxed environment
JavaScript execution must be sandboxed
SSL certificate validation must be enforced
No access to vehicle APIs from browser context
Browsing history must be clearable by user

use_cases.name: Apple CarPlay Connection
use_cases.description: User connects iPhone to use Apple CarPlay interface
preconditions: iPhone with CarPlay support connected via USB or wireless
main_flow: User connects iPhone via USB cable or initiates wireless CarPlay
System authenticates device using MFi protocol
System launches CarPlay interface
iPhone screen is mirrored/projected to IVI display
User interacts with CarPlay apps (Maps, Music, Phone)
security_requirements: Only MFi certified connections allowed
CarPlay interface isolated from native IVI apps
Audio routing controlled by IVI, not iPhone
No direct CAN bus access from CarPlay

use_cases.name: Voice Command Recognition
use_cases.description: User controls IVI functions using voice commands
main_flow: User speaks wake word or presses voice button
System activates voice recognition
User speaks command
System processes speech locally or via cloud
System executes recognized command
System provides audio feedback
security_requirements: Voice data sent to cloud must be encrypted
Voice recordings must not be stored without consent
Critical vehicle commands require confirmation
Speaker verification for sensitive operations (optional)

use_cases.name: Vehicle Diagnostics Display
use_cases.description: System displays vehicle diagnostic information to user
main_flow: User navigates to vehicle status screen
System retrieves vehicle data via CAN bus
System displays tire pressure, fuel level, range, etc.
System displays any active warnings or DTCs
security_requirements: Diagnostic data read-only for user interface
No write access to ECU parameters from IVI
DTC details should not expose security-sensitive codes

use_cases.name: WiFi Hotspot Sharing
use_cases.description: IVI provides WiFi hotspot for passenger devices using cellular data
main_flow: User enables WiFi hotspot from settings
System creates WiFi access point
Passengers connect their devices
Traffic is routed through cellular modem
security_requirements: WPA3 encryption required for hotspot
Client isolation must be enabled
Hotspot traffic must be isolated from vehicle network
Maximum client limit enforced
Data usage tracking required

data_assets.name: User Contacts
data_assets.retention: Until user deletion or factory reset
